title: Two-Pole Directional Concept Separation
intuition: Fast 80-step directional separation probe testing whether adversarial training moves opposing concept poles apart cleanly (mean_abs >= 0.30) while keeping critic spatial gradients bounded (grad_med <= 1.0).
failure_mode: Under-regularized critics develop sharp spikes (grad_med > 1.0), whereas overly damped or sluggish trainers fail to separate the two poles within the 80-update window.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required behavioral gate (80 updates, 24 observations, 5 sustained terminal checks).
